findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: onchain_agent_get_resource, onchain_agent_recent_changes, onchain_agent_get_news, onchain_agent_search_agents, onchain_agent_get_changes, onchain_agent_get_trend, onchain_agent_explain_number · Private data: onchain_agent_search_resources, onchain_agent_get_resource, onchain_agent_get_deploy_spec, onchain_agent_get_metrics, onchain_agent_recommend_stack, onchain_agent_get_changes, onchain_agent_search_skills, onchain_agent_compare_listings, onchain_agent_get_listing_history · Public sink: onchain_agent_get_news, onchain_agent_get_listing_history · Destructive: onchain_agent_search_resources.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: onchain_agent_get_resource, onchain_agent_recent_changes, onchain_agent_get_news, onchain_agent_search_agents, onchain_agent_get_changes, onchain_agent_get_trend, onchain_agent_explain_number · Private data: onchain_agent_search_resources, onchain_agent_get_resource, onchain_agent_get_deploy_spec, onchain_agent_get_metrics, onchain_agent_recommend_stack, onchain_agent_get_changes, onchain_agent_search_skills, onchain_agent_compare_listings, onchain_agent_get_listing_history · Public sink: onchain_agent_get_news, onchain_agent_get_listing_history · Destructive: onchain_agent_search_resources

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
